text: Part six. Bit is alive. Inside *Gray Tower*.

speaker: narrator
text: Saturday night. The plan is *simple*.

speaker: hero
text: Simple? I have to climb *ninety floors*.

speaker: friend
text: And I have to be the city's *brightest thing*.

speaker: narrator
text: Mia raids the store. Every flashlight. Every *glow stick*.

speaker: narrator
text: At one in the morning, she lights *everything*.

speaker: friend
text: Hey! Over here! *Brightest girl in town*!

speaker: narrator
text: The zombies let go of the tower. *And follow*.

speaker: narrator
text: Rook drives her through the streets like a *parade*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay slips into the empty tower and starts *climbing*.

speaker: narrator
text: Floor ten. Floor forty. His legs are *on fire*.

speaker: hero
text: Note to self. Next apocalypse, *learn to fly*.

speaker: narrator
text: Floor sixty. Something is standing on the *stairs*.

speaker: narrator
text: One zombie that didn't follow the lights. Still *gripping*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay holds his breath and squeezes *past it*.

speaker: narrator
text: Floor ninety. A door. A *glowing* room.

speaker: narrator
text: Inside, Bit is plugged into the antenna. *Cables everywhere*.

speaker: bit
text: Jay? You climbed ninety floors? You hate *stairs*!

speaker: boss
text: And he's right on time. It's almost *noon*.

speaker: narrator
text: Part seven drops in two days.
